answer: Each identity must finish a chain of dependent modular squarings before producing a Wesolowski proof; the next step cannot be computed until the previous one is known. Separate chains labeled willow, falcon, or ocean can run on separate hardware, so GPUs are not categorically useless, but cloning identities multiplies the work rather than sharing one chain. This creates a measurable time-and-compute cost, not an absolute bar to Sybil attacks.
